instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with duotone weight for a highly technical feel. Alternatively use lucide-react if already installed, keeping icons sharp and small.

Use Recharts for the MNQ Futures Tracker and P&L charts. Customize axes to use JetBrains Mono, remove chart grids entirely or use very faint white/5 opacity lines. Add VWAP, 9 EMA, 21 EMA, RSI overlays natively.
For live prices, ensure all numbers are tabulated using JetBrains Mono (font-mono) so digits align perfectly vertically. Add `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` to global CSS for tables.
Do NOT use thick rounded corners. The app must feel like a precision instrument (rounded-sm or rounded-none).
Use Shadcn UI tables but strip out the generous padding to make them dense ('p-1' or 'p-2'). Use Mode B 'Control Room Grid' styling.
Implement Sonner toasts for Breakout and VWAP alerts with custom styling: dark background and neon green/red borders based on alert type.
The UI must prioritize data density. The 'Control Room Grid' means using almost every pixel. Utilize h-full on widgets to stretch them correctly.
Never use generic placeholders. Use the provided Unsplash images for backgrounds behind empty state panels, set to very low opacity (10%).
Implement pure CSS neon text shadows for active price changes (e.g., text-green-500 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(34,197,94,0.8)]).
Ensure all interactive elements have descriptive, role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='buy-mnq-button', data-testid='watchlist-item-sofi').
You have .js files not .tsx files, keep components clean of typescript types.
